verdict.rationale: Docs confirm fraud/risk monitoring ('identify fraudulent behavior, stop suspicious payouts, flag unusual user activities'), configurable risk rules or outsourced risk management, chargeback handling options, and ability to control/stop payouts — covering the core ops needs of watching risk and pausing payouts. However, there's no evidence of a dedicated per-sub-merchant risk dashboard/portfolio view, explicit anomaly alerting mechanism, or an offboarding workflow tool distinct from generic account deactivation webhooks. Missing for 10: a described portfolio-wide risk dashboard/scoring UI, explicit anomaly-alert configuration, and a documented seller offboarding workflow beyond account status webhooks.
